hero.description: Kinetic hero with large masked line-by-line reveal of the tagline. A monumental architectural shot with a subtle parallax effect on scroll.
hero.structure: 100vh height. Text positioned centrally or left-aligned with a massive H1. Image acts as a rich, cinematic background layer (using react-spring-parallax or framer-motion) with an overlay of bg-black/40.

navigation.description: Fixed/Sticky top nav with a Crystal Glass effect. Contains dropdown menus.
navigation.style: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0B0E]/70 border-b border-white/10. NO purely transparent backgrounds for dropdown menus; menus must have solid or heavy glass background.

marquee.description: Slow editorial marquee band acting as a section separator.
marquee.style: font-heading italic text-4xl text-accent_primary/80 py-8 border-y border-white/10. Use react-fast-marquee. Items separated by an elegant geometric dot.

manifesto_chapters.style: Bento or staggered asymmetric grid. Massive numbers (e.g., '01', '02') in font-mono or font-heading, text-8xl opacity-20. Delicate body text next to it.

works_grid.description: Filterable project grid with editorial photography treatment.
works_grid.style: Generous negative space. Images have clipped frames (aspect-video or aspect-[4/5]). Spotlight hover effect on project cards.

admin_dashboard.description: Admin panel for managing projects and leads.
admin_dashboard.style: High-contrast dark mode using Shadcn UI. Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm max). Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle borders. Vibrant accent for primary actions.

motion.reveal: Framer Motion. Use a mask-image technique or overflow-hidden div wrappers for line-by-line text reveals on load.
motion.hover: Subtle image scaling (scale 1.05) inside overflow-hidden containers. Text color transitions.
motion.parallax: Use Framer Motion's useScroll and useTransform to create subtle Y-axis translation on hero and massive section images.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the #0A0B0E background has at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Use the text_primary and accent colors appropriately.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the parallax and line-by-line reveals.

instructions_to_main_agent: Commit fully to the dark luxury editorial theme. No generic gradient backgrounds. Rely on high-contrast typography, deep blacks, and crisp 1px borders.
Use Framer Motion for the hero line-by-line reveal. Wrap each line of text in an overflow-hidden span, and animate the inner span from translateY(100%) to 0.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling globally.
For the Dropdown Nav, use Shadcn NavigationMenu or DropdownMenu but heavily customize it. Ensure the dropdown background is solid (#0A0B0E) or heavily blurred. DO NOT leave it transparent.
In 'Our Works', use clipped aspect ratios for images and apply a hover state where the image subtly scales up while the container stays fixed (overflow-hidden).
For the Marquee, use react-fast-marquee. Set the speed slow, and use the heading font (Cormorant Garamond) in italic to create an elegant editorial separator.
The admin panel should be separate (e.g. /admin) and use Shadcn components styled with sharp borders and flat colors, avoiding excessive rounded corners.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
DO NOT output standard centered text layouts. Stagger elements. Use bento grids with wide gaps (gap-8 or gap-12).
DO NOT use Inter for any headings.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
